task_metadata.research_topic: epoch-level learning-rate scheduler design for MNIST classification with a fixed Adadelta optimizer
task_metadata.research_question: Can an improved epoch-level learning-rate schedule outperform the default StepLR schedule on the PyTorch MNIST example without changing the model or optimizer?
notes: Task framing comes from task_description.md and the referenced PyTorch MNIST example.
The warmup_cosine baseline is linked approximately because the repo baseline combines linear warmup and cosine decay without citing a single canonical implementation paper.

tests.label: train
tests.notes: The training command runs the PyTorch MNIST CNN with Adadelta; the LeCun et al. paper covers the canonical MNIST/CNN benchmark and ADADELTA covers the optimizer family used by the task.

baselines.name: cosine_annealing
baselines.notes: Maps to the cosine annealing component popularized by SGDR; the repo baseline omits warm restarts, so the mapping is approximate rather than exact.

baselines.name: warmup_cosine
baselines.notes: Matches the common linear-warmup plus cosine-decay recipe described in large-batch and image-classification training papers, but the repo baseline is a custom simplified implementation.
